name: Runner Extras - Query Column Filter
brief: Regression for issue #2418: a query column's static ColumnFilter property was dropped on the way from the symbol reference into the runner-synthesized query metadata, and the runner's query execution never consulted NCLMetaQuery.ColumnFilters, so a filter(> 0) on a Method = Sum column did not drop the groups whose total fails it.
description: The BC-language contract this exercises - a ColumnFilter on an aggregated column filters the aggregated value, on a plain column it filters the source rows, and a runtime SetFilter/SetRange on the same column replaces the static filter - is a plain BC-behaviour claim and belongs upstream in the al-language corpus (see the runner repo's bc-behavior-tests-go-upstream.md); every shape here was measured on a real BC 28.4 service tier before the issue was filed. This suite is the runner-repo-local stopgap so this repo's own CI gates the fix now; once the corpus test lands and the pin moves it may be retired.
